claims.summary: Healthy native assembly validates the native wire map as CourseIR and projects the compile graph from CurriculumV1 before deliverable compilation.
CourseIR projection preserves real native readings/resources and prevents CourseIR support notes from becoming fake resource registry entries.
The runtime log and pipeline decision now disclose healthy native CurriculumV1 source-graph projection separately from sparse-plan repair.
Package manifests include courseIR.nativeAssembly proof for healthy native CourseIR projection and disclose edits after projection.
Course-map edits on CurriculumV1-projected native graphs retain stable native entity ids while preserving CourseIR projection metadata.
